f.pu: The reserve was created in order to preserve the unique marine ecological system, where organic substances are created both through photosynthesis and bacterial chemosynthesis, which is of scientific interest in terms of developing the biological production of organic substances.
f.re: Prohibited activities and nature uses include: 1. disembarkation and stay on the territory of the reserve of persons without special permission from the KTOF navigation department; 2. any activity not related to research work; 3. approach to the island, passage to the bay and parking of vessels, including small ones, in the water area of ​​the reserve without special permission from the protection authorities (excep…
